evidence.title: Tools - Free, No Signup, Online Chart Makers

name: Graphitup Tools
summary: Free no-signup online chart makers: line, bar, pie, donut, bubble, scatter, area, gauge, radar and an AI graph maker.
description: A hub of free browser-based chart and graph makers — line, bar, stacked, double, horizontal, pie, donut, bubble, scatter, area, gauge, radar and an AI graph maker. Each tool imports data from Excel, Google Sheets or Google Drive and exports the chart as a shareable image.
contains: 17 free chart makers, incl. line, bar, pie, donut, scatter and an AI graph maker
also stacked, double, horizontal, multi-line, multi-bar, area, gauge, radar and percentages
data import from Excel, Google Sheets or Google Drive
charts download in any size or file format; no signup for the free tools
part of Graphitup, a platform that turns spreadsheets into interactive embeddable charts
free tier plus paid Creator ($20), Growth ($40) and Enterprise plans
